about_the_game: The Soundtrack Collection of Wuxia and Fantasy Role-playing Game 'The Forgotten Concluder', meticulously curated by renowned composer Chen Guanming, features 30 exquisite background music tracks used throughout the game. This collection allows you to revisit the magnificent realm above the heaven at any time and savor each captivating chapter of this epic tale.

short_description: “The Forgotten Concluder” is a third person perspective 3D Role-playing game base on the ancient Chinese fantasy wu-xia world. Being a young teenager Shen Zi-Jun that grew in a isolated valley, taking on a adventure to discover a great secret and his true dentity.
